## Execution gate
Creating or prioritizing this issue does not approve implementation. Menu eligibility requires explicit human approval, Delivery Ready, no owner/claim, dependencies met, and no overlapping active branch/PR. Recheck live issue, approval evidence, dependencies and PRs immediately before claiming or starting. Labels and this template do not enforce approval.
